Free TI-84 Calculator Online

Independent website. Vertex is not affiliated with Texas Instruments. It runs the TI-84 Plus CE on an open source emulator.

About Vertex

Welcome to Vertex, a free TI-84 Plus CE graphing calculator that runs in your browser. It uses CEmu, an open source emulator, to run the real TI-OS on emulated hardware. You get the same keys, menus, and results as the handheld, on any device, with nothing to install.

Vertex is for students, teachers, and anyone who needs a graphing calculator for math, science, engineering, or statistics. You bring one thing: a ROM file from your own calculator. You load it once and Vertex remembers it.

Key Features

📊 Graphing Functions

Plot and analyze several functions, parametric equations, polar graphs, and sequences at the same time.

📈 Statistical Analysis

Run regressions, calculate statistics, and draw plots such as histograms and box plots.

🔢 Advanced Math

Work with complex numbers, matrices, lists, and more.

💻 Web-Based

Nothing to install. Vertex runs in your browser on a computer, tablet, or phone.

🎯 Real TI-OS

Vertex runs the actual TI-OS from your own calculator, so the keys, menus, and results match the handheld.

🔧 Zoom Controls

Make the calculator bigger or smaller with the zoom buttons. Vertex remembers your choice.

How to Use

  1. Load your ROM once. Choose the ROM file from your own calculator, or drop it on the screen. Vertex keeps it in your browser, so you only do this one time.
  2. Use your mouse, touchscreen, or keyboard to press the calculator buttons.
  3. Adjust the size with the zoom controls (+ and -) at the top.
  4. Start calculating! The real TI-OS runs, so everything works like a physical TI-84 Plus CE. You can also drop a program file, such as a .8xp, onto the calculator to send it.

Perfect For

Students: Do homework and practice for tests on a computer, even when your handheld is at home.

Teachers: Show calculator steps on a projector or interactive whiteboard during lessons.

Parents: Check homework with the same calculator your child uses at school.

Professionals: Run quick calculations and graphs for work projects.

Supported Functions

Vertex runs the real TI-OS, so it supports the functions of the TI-84 Plus CE, including:

  • Basic arithmetic operations
  • Trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan, and inverses)
  • Logarithmic and exponential functions
  • Matrix operations
  • Complex number calculations
  • Statistical calculations and distributions
  • Graphing with zoom and trace
  • Programming in TI-BASIC
  • List operations
  • Table generation
  • Program and variable files sent from your computer

System Requirements

Vertex works on any device with:

  • A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
  • An internet connection for the first load
  • JavaScript and WebAssembly turned on
  • A ROM file from your own TI-84 Plus CE calculator (Vertex does not provide one)

Works in current browsers on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and Chrome OS.
